value.rationale: The Bidiakis cube is a canonical nonbipartite cubic polyhedral graph, making its exact two-opinion majority dynamics a natural benchmark rather than an arbitrary graph selection. This complete census determines all attractors, a sharp and substantially nontrivial six-update cutoff, exact transient populations, every individual orbit-basin size, and the geometric symmetry classification. These precise quantities test and inform structural descriptions of local voting dynamics on cubic graph geometries; no bigger theorem is claimed.
